trial_court: LIII Addl. City Civil & Sessions Special Judge, Bengaluru (Spl CC No. 260 /2013)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: State of Karnataka, by Yelahanka New Town Police Station

facts_of_case: Accused Sayabanna kidnapped a minor girl and took her to his native place Gulbarga. He wrongfully confined her and had sexual intercourse with her repeatedly. The case was registered against him in Crime No. 191/2013 for the offence punishable under Section 363 IPC.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the consent was obtained through fear, coercion, or fraud.
legal_principles.held: Though she has stated about Music Class joined by her on 18/8/2013, no documents produced before the Court.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not accept a false complaint given to break legal marriage.
legal_principles.held: However, she has disclosed the Register marriage of her with the Accused to here parents. She has denied that she herself voluntarily married the Accused, thereafter their marriage was Registered in the office of the Sub- Registrar at Yelahanka.

outcome.final_order: The trial court framed charges against the accused under Sections 366, 342, 376 IPC and 5(1) R/w 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

keywords: LIII Addl. City Civil & Sessions Special Judge
